# telnyx_10dlc_brand_external_vetting_order (Action)

Orders an external vetting of a 10DLC brand from a vetting provider approved by The Campaign Registry. Vetting is billable, and a duplicate order for the same provider and class within 180 days of a successful vetting is refused.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) The brand id.
- `evp_id` (String) External vetting provider ID for the brand.
- `vetting_class` (String) Identifies the vetting classification.
